How each number is calculated
  • Working capital released = annual revenue ÷ 365 × DSO reduction days.
  • Financing value = working capital released × cost of capital.
  • Bank fee reduction = annual bank fees × fee reduction %.
  • STP gains = payments × (target STP − current STP) × cost per manual payment.
  • Exception effort avoided = exceptions × share resolved × cost per exception.
  • Payback = one-time investment ÷ (annual benefit ÷ 12). 3-year net = 3 × annual benefit − investment.

Illustrative estimates only, based entirely on the assumptions entered. These are not benchmarks, quotes or measured client results. Excludes tax, FX, implementation timing and ramp-up. Nothing you enter is sent or stored.
